questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Sacred
questions.solution:
A)Sacred(adjective) – Regarded with great respect and reverence, often in a religious context. पवित्र
Antonym: Profane(adjective) – Not respectful of religious practice; irreverent, secular, non-religious. अपवित्र

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.
My most vivid recollection of that summer is the ocean
questions.solution: A)Vivid(adjective) – Producing powerful feelings or strong, clear images in the mind; bright, distinct, and clear. जीवंत; सुस्पष्टAntonym:Vague(adjective) – Not clearly expressed, not specific, unclear, hazy. अस्पष्ट

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Alive
questions.solution:
D)Alive(adjective) – Living, not dead, active, existing, vibrant. जीवित
Antonym:Dead(adjective) – Not alive, lifeless, deceased, inanimate. मृत

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.
Mr. Stein is a very cold and hard man.
questions.solution:
D) Hard (adjective) – Unyielding, tough, rigid, severe.कठोर
Antonym: Option B) Clement (adjective) – Mild, merciful, lenient, compassionate. उदार/ मेहरबान
Option D) Charitable (adjective) – Generous, benevolent, kind, giving. परोपकारी
Note: Disputed question, in the real answer key both option B and D are correct so we have changed the (B) option from clement to Robust

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.
You should never visit her without her consent
questions.solution:
B)Consent(noun) – Permission for something to happen or agreement to do something. सहमति
Antonym:Refusal(noun) – An act of saying or showing that you will not do, give, or accept something. अस्वीकृति

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.
The plot of the novel is very dull.
questions.solution:
D) Dull (adjective)– Lacking interest or excitement, boring, uninteresting, monotonous. नीरस
Antonym:Riveting (adjective)– Completely engrossing, fascinating, captivating, absorbing. मंत्रमुग्ध कर देने वाला

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.
The upshot of the consultation with the doctor was an operation scheduled for the next week
questions.solution:
D)Upshot(noun) – The final or eventual outcome or conclusion. परिणाम
Antonym:Cause(noun) – A person or thing that gives rise to an action, phenomenon, or condition. कारण बनना; पहुंचाना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in the bracket to fill in the blank.
The State media houses present ______ (vociferous) views compared to private media
questions.solution:
D) Vociferous(adjective) –Vehement,clamorous,loud,outspoken.जोरदार
Antonym:Mild(adjective) –Gentle,soft,quiet,calm.कोमल/ हल्का

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.
Few people turned up to attend the tawdry promo of the new movie
questions.solution:
B) Tawdry(adjective) – Showy but cheap and of poor quality, gaudy, flashy, garish. बेढब; भडकीला
Antonym:Elegant(adjective) – Graceful and stylish in appearance or manner, sophisticated, tasteful. सुरुचिपूर्ण; शिष्ट

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the sentence.
He tried to improve the working conditions in his office
questions.solution:
B)Improve(verb) – To make better, enhance, upgrade, refine. सुधारना
Antonym:Spoil(verb) – To damage, ruin, destroy, impair. बिगाड़ना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Cheerful
questions.solution:
A)Cheerful(adjective) – Happy, joyful, upbeat, merry. हंसमुख
Antonym:Gloomy(adjective) – Dark or poorly lit, especially so as to appear depressing or frightening; sad, unhappy. उदास

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.
This makes readers contemplate the motives people have for performing acts of charity
questions.solution:
B)Contemplate(verb) – Think about, consider, ponder, reflect upon. विचार करना/ सोचना
Antonym:Overlook(verb) – Fail to notice, ignore, neglect. नज़रअंदाज़ करना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Important
questions.solution:
B)Important(adjective) – Of great significance or value, essential, crucial, key. महत्वपूर्ण
Antonym:Trivial(adjective) – Of little value or importance, insignificant, minor. तुच्छ

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Merit
questions.solution:
A)Merit(noun) – The quality of being particularly good or worthy, especially so as to deserve praise or reward. योग्यता, गुण
Antonym:Fault(noun) – An unattractive or unsatisfactory feature, especially in a piece of work or in a person's character. दोष

questions.question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.
Gentlemen always go for a lawful approach, but rouges choose ______ ways to solve problems.
questions.solution:
C)Lawful(adjective) – Legal, legitimate, permitted by law. वैध
Antonym:Illicit(adjective) – Forbidden by law, rules, or custom, illegal, unlawful. गैरकानूनी

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.
There is also an increase in juvenile delinquency.
questions.solution:
D) Juvenile(adjective) – Relating to young people, youthful, adolescent. किशोर
Antonym:Adult(adjective) – Fully grown or developed, mature, grown-up. वयस्क

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Alluring
questions.solution:
D)Alluring(adjective) – Powerfully and mysteriously attractive or fascinating; seductive. आकर्षक
Antonym:Repulsive(adjective) – Arousing intense distaste or disgust; offensive, unattractive. घृणास्पद

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Resourceful
questions.solution:
A) Resourceful (adjective)– Having the ability to find quick and clever ways to overcome difficulties, inventive, capable. संसाधन संपन्न
Antonym: Incompetent(adjective) – Not having or showing the necessary skills to do something successfully, inept, unskilled. अक्षम

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Agile
questions.solution:
A) Agile(adjective) – Quick and light in movement or action, nimble, spry, lively. चुस्त
Antonym:Sluggish(adjective) – Slow-moving or inactive, lethargic, lacking energy, unenergetic. सुस्त

questions.question: The balloon started to deflate after being pricked with a needle. What is the ANTONYM of ‘deflate’?
questions.solution:
C) Deflate (verb)– To let air or gas out of something, causing it to shrink, flatten, or collapse. हवा निकालना
Antonym: Inflate (verb)– To fill with air or gas, causing it to expand or swell. फुलाना
